summary.title: [Calculator] Accepted imperial boundary weights become invalid after switching to metric
summary.one_line_description: The unit switch displays an in-range metric weight but validates the unrounded canonical value, disabling results for an input that was valid before the switch.

bug_1.file_locations: - /Users/sacino/musclehacking/src/features/calculator/Calculator.tsx - functions: `toCalculatorInput`, `updateNumeric`, and `updateUnits`, Lines 241-277 and 348-403 - /Users/sacino/musclehacking/src/features/calculator/domain/validation.ts - `CALCULATOR_BOUNDS` and `validateCalculatorInput`, Lines 13-25 and 48-82 - /Users/sacino/musclehacking/tests/e2e/interactions.spec.ts - test: `calculator unit toggle preserves results for the same physical inputs`, Lines 20-41

issue_description.description: The calculator accepts 66.1 lb as the documented imperial minimum. Editing that value stores its exact conversion, approximately 29.9825 kg, in `canonicalWeightKg`. Switching to metric renders the rounded display value `30`, but `toCalculatorInput` validates the unchanged canonical value against the 30 kg minimum. The visible 30 kg field therefore receives `aria-invalid="true"`, shows “Enter a value from 30 to 300 kg.”, replaces the results with an error summary, and disables copy. The same mismatch occurs at the accepted 661.4 lb maximum: the UI displays 300 kg while the canonical value is approximately 300.0064 kg and is rejected. This was reproduced in the built page at `/calorie-calculator/` by selecting Imperial, entering 66.1 lb, and switching back to Metric. The existing round-trip test only uses the default 80 kg value, so it does not exercise either accepted imperial boundary.
issue_description.expected_vs_actual: | Aspect | Expected | Actual | |--------|----------|--------| | **Unit round trip** | An accepted imperial boundary remains valid after switching units | 66.1 lb and 661.4 lb become invalid after switching to metric | | **Visible validation** | Displayed 30 kg and 300 kg values pass their stated 30-300 kg bounds | The displayed values are rejected because hidden canonical values fall just outside the bounds | | **Calculator result** | Results remain available for the same accepted physical input | Results are replaced by an error and the copy control is disabled | | **Recommendation** | Align conversion rounding, canonical state, and validation tolerance so the value shown to the user is the value judged against the active unit bounds; add boundary round-trip browser regressions | Only the default 80 kg round trip is currently covered |
